Ellen (PM): Quick run: we need final guidance on network modes for GA. Field keeps asking "which mode is cheapest vs fastest". Let's capture cost/latency tradeoffs and a buyer rubric.
Ravi (Eng): Short answer: preserve=lowest egress cost and lowest latency when peer is in-region, but highest operational surface. Relay=fastest to install, control-plane protected, higher egress multiplier and ~50-200ms added tail depending on region. Managed-SNAT is middle: per-tenant IPs, moderate cost, easier than full BGP.
Noor (Solutions): From sales feedback: banks and healthcare want preserve. Scaleups want managed-snat. SMBs want relay. We should give an explicit recommended default and two upgrade lanes.
Hank (SRE): Ops signals: track p95 egress_tail_ms, bgp_flaps/hr, snat_pool_util_pct. Preserve requires BGP session healthchecks and route validation before cutover. Relay needs egress capacity alarms.
Ravi (Eng): Upgrade lanes:
- Relay -> Managed-SNAT: zero-downtime if SNAT pool provisioned, can cutover with NAT rules swap.
- Managed-SNAT -> Preserve: needs preflight CIDR check + peering dry-run + maintenance window for BGP adj.
Document will require image compatibility checks: preserve gate = operator >=1.3.0; SNAT >=1.2.0; relay back to 1.0.x.
Noor (Solutions): I'll prepare a 1-page buyer rubric: recommended mode by profile, cost delta (estimates), and required NetOps artifacts (CIDRs, ASN, firewall text).
Ellen (PM): Can we add a minimal CLI snippet for quickstart?
Ravi (Eng): Yep: relay quickstart:
```bash
./redwood-installer --network-mode=relay --region=us-east-1 --operator-version=1.2.0
```
SNAT preflight:
```bash
./redwood-installer --network-mode=snat --preflight --snat-pool=10.240.0.0/24
```
Preserve dry-run:
```bash
./redwood-installer --network-mode=preserve --preflight-only --reserved-cidrs=10.241.0.0/24
```
Hank (SRE): Add runbook checklist: for preserve we require NetOps contact, CIDR non-overlap confirmation, a 2h maintenance window, and a rollback path. Also publish per-tenant dashboards with the SLIs above.
Ellen (PM): Action items: 1) Ravi: write spec for preflight & cutover flows + compatibility matrix (due 6 working days). 2) Noor: buyer rubric + firewall copy (due 3 working days). 3) Hank: SLIs, alerts, and dashboard mock (due 7 working days). 4) I'll draft GTM language and default policy.
Scheduler-bot: Reminder created: "priv-net-modes-review" on 2024-07-19 14:00 UTC.
Noor (Solutions): UX note: surface selected mode in console with an admin-only toggle and inline warning when switching to preserve.
Ravi (Eng): Cost note: include a table in docs showing relative egress multiplier and expected latency delta for common regions.
Ellen (PM): OK locking this thread as the canonical snipe for decisions. We'll update if specs change. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
